Test Summary: Validate column layout visibility for end-user
Objective: Ensure user can see column layout on CPS Energy website pages
Test Data: Page with Column Control component added
Steps: 1. Navigate to CPS Energy website page with Column Control component
Expected Result: Column layout is visible to the user

Test Summary: Validate author can add Column Control component
Objective: Ensure author can add Column Control to a page
Test Data: Author credentials, access to authoring interface
Steps:
1. Log in as author
2. Open page in authoring mode
3. Add Column Control component
4. Publish or preview the page
Expected Result: Column Control component is added and visible on the page

Steps:
1. Add Column Control component in AEM 6.2 and 6.5
2. Select each layout option
3. Compare rendered output

Test Summary: Validate unauthorized user cannot author Column Control

Expected Result: Unauthorized user is denied access to authoring actions

Test Summary: Validate invalid column layout selection is handled
Objective: Ensure system handles invalid or unsupported layout selection gracefully

2. Attempt to select an invalid or unsupported column layout
3. Publish or preview the page
Expected Result: System prevents invalid selection or displays error message
